item.title: Blood of Dawnwalker’s Massive Update Is Finally Here and the Full List of Changes Is Wild
item.description: Just over a month after first revealing that it was working on a substantial post-release patch for The Blood of Dawnwalker , developer Rebel Wolves has released update 1.1. The long-awaited overhaul of the vampire RPG brings new features, system improvements, and the only thing that ever really matters in a video game: the ability to pet animals.

item.title: 'The Walking Dead' Star’s Resident Evil Fan Film Sets a Surprising Record
item.description: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil has been a hit with critics and audiences alike, earning rave reviews and setting box office records for the long-running horror franchise. You'd think the filmmaker's big-budget reboot would be the highest-rated Resident Evil adaptation to come out this year, too.

item.title: 'Marvel’s Wolverine' Soars on PS5 Sales Charts Despite Negative Buzz
item.description: Don’t believe everything you see on the internet. After Marvel’s Wolverine became a laughingstock on social media, with widely circulated clips blasting the game’s “fart trail” UI and lackluster chase sequences, the game seems to have done quite well from a sales perspective . According to new data from industry analyst group Circana, Marvel’s Wolverine was September's best-selling game in the United States across physical and digital. Not bad for a console exclusive with an already infamous reputation.

item.description: That legacy is perhaps most succinctly memorialized by a former Veilguard writer, who shared in a post on Bluesky a quote from Rook, the game’s main character: “We will always be grateful for those whose stories brought us where we are today. item.title: Video Game Industry Responds to BioWare Shutting Down
item.description: Electronic Arts revealed on Wednesday that the legendary RPG studio BioWare is no more . The sudden shuttering wasn't exactly a surprise to onlookers — recent BioWare releases received mixed reviews and middling sales numbers — but deep down, many were hoping that the developer could find its footing again. Seemingly every gamer and industry worker of a certain era still has fond memories of surviving Mass Effect 2 's suicide mission, or romancing a character in Dragon Age: Origins .

item.title: Award-Winning Sci-Fi Author Reveals Role on Canceled Mass Effect
item.description: The fifth installment in BioWare's Mass Effect series was announced six years ago . But the game was still in early development by a small team, and we never got to know much about the game, including who was hired to work on it.

item.title: Dungeon Crawler Carl Is Officially Getting a New Release Next Year
item.description: Even if you haven't read any of the books, you've probably heard of Dungeon Crawler Carl at this point. The LitRPG series (a genre defined by its use of video game and tabletop RPG mechanics) by Matt Dinniman has become a cultural juggernaut, and it is only getting bigger. In addition to a television adaptation , Dungeon Crawler Carl is also being adapted into a comic book.

item.title: Mass Effect: Universe Trailer Leaks, Revealing BioWare’s Final Game
item.description: After news of BioWare's closure broke , fans were confused: how could Mass Effect 5 still be in "early" development if it was announced five years ago, in 2020? The next day, a short clip allegedly from the project leaked online, and it seems to answer the question of where Mass Effect 5' s development progress actually stood.

item.title: Superhero Workplace Comedy Hit 'Dispatch' Reveals Huge Update and New Platforms
item.description: It’s been a busy first year at the Superhero Dispatch Network, and Dispatch is celebrating with a whole lot of new content. AdHoc Studio’s hit narrative adventure is getting two new behind-the-scenes modes, a mobile release date, and more.

item.title: Winter Sotoyama region treasure hunt location in Forza Horizon 6
item.description: The winter Sotoyama region treasure hunt is one of the weekly activities in Forza Horizon 6 Series 6, "Horizon Meets." Whenever a new hunt begins, a box appears somewhere on the map and, to locate it, the only hints you have are the region's name and a picture. Completing this challenge helps you get closer to claiming the weekly and the Series cars.
